events.text: Root cause confirmed from the active ground formula: laneNorth/laneSouth/laneEast/laneWest had no default material entries, so every carriageway cell fell through to concrete; only median was road-bound. The median/road fill also consumed unrotated per-tile UVs. Fix binds all lane/junction cells to asphalt, binds the median to its marking variant, and rotates/infer axes from the semantic lane kinds so markings run with the road.

resolution: Fixed the pictured road surface failure at its material boundary: directional lane kinds and junctions now bind explicitly to asphalt instead of falling through to concrete, the median uses its marking variant, east-west lane UVs rotate, and neutral median/crosswalk cells infer axis from adjacent directional lanes so markings follow the road. Focused ground-formula tests and the full ReleaseFast editor build pass; user visual confirmation on existing and newly committed roads remains.
